name: stock-direction-signals
description: Provider-filtered stock direction research — Alpha Vantage MPP for quote/chart/technicals/news/earnings, SELAT-native Twitter for social chatter, Circle StableEnrich for Reddit, Circle Otto for TradFi macro — fused into a non-advisory bullish/bearish/mixed brief. Paid per call via selat-pay across mixed rails (x402 via Circle Gateway + x402 on Base + MPP on Tempo) via the SELAT Router.

ticker.description: US equity ticker or index proxy (used as ${ticker}). Always pass the user's ticker explicitly; never let the default silently research another company.

twitter_query.description: SELAT-native Twitter advanced-search query (used as ${twitter_query}). Widen with company and product terms, e.g. "$NVDA OR NVIDIA OR Blackwell". Retarget alongside ticker.

reddit_query.description: Reddit search query for Circle StableEnrich (used as ${reddit_query}). Add company and product terms for richer threads. Retarget alongside ticker.

steps.label: twitter chatter — SELAT-native advanced search (x402 via Circle Gateway)
macro regime — Circle Otto tradfi-data (x402 on Base)

daily chart — Alpha Vantage time-series-daily (MPP on Tempo)
